# Gertie Pye

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Gertie Pye is known for her dishonest behavior, with others regarding her as a cheat. She also has a habit of constantly squeaking her pencil, a noise that deeply irritates those around her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)_

## History

Gertie Pye was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who warmly welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back when she returned to school after being separated from [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII.
